answer.rationale: Memory 57 most directly supports sustainable qualified revenue because it reports qualified revenue gains and no measurable retention harm. Memory 44 provides strong evidence through higher-quality enterprise pipeline, though realized revenue and long-term retention are omitted. Memories 31 and 86 show durable or adoption-related funnel improvements but do not connect them to qualified revenue. Memory 73 reports acquisition and revenue lift in the currently threatened segment, but omits customer quality, margin, retention, and post-promotion durability. Memory 91 is weakest because it only establishes improved early engagement and first action, without evidence of durability, qualification, retention, or revenue impact.
